description.text: When you apply for this program, you only need to fill out the department or school in the online application form. Students will choose their specific major opened in this department in the third year. This program belongs to YuanPei School. YuanPei School You could choose any major opened in Peking University Students are required to complete the curriculum between 4 to 6 years and fulfill the designated number of credits. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the bachelor’s degree, according to the regulation of the Degree Committee. When to apply early January - early March Please visit cucas for the latest information. Applicants must come in person to Peking University to submit their application materials, or entrust someone else to submit the materials on their behalf. At present, mailed materials are not accepted. Entrance examination dates The written tests is early April. For the details of test venue and time, please refer to your Admission Card. The applicants who pass the written tests are required to attend an interview. Date and venue will be informed after the written tests. Entrance examination subjects Humanities/ Science: Chinese language Mathematics English Admission Admission will be determined according to the applicants' educational background, the results of the Entrance examinations and the interview. The admission result will be available in the end of May. The 'Letter of Admission' and the attached documents can be obtained by the end of June. Registration Period September (specified in the Letter of Admission)

duration.text: The Experiment Class for Liberal Arts at Peking University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included (passport type must be ordinary) 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. High school academic transcript Official transcripts of your academic achievement up to the present, including courses taken and standard achieved (original documents or certified copies in Chinese or English) 4. High school graduate certificate Students expecting to graduate should provide an official letter stating expected graduation date, and submit the graduation diploma if admitted, which should be original documents or certified copies in Chinese or English 5. Additional materials Additional materials may be required Note: After passing the initial review, you should mail relevant materials to CUCAS as we tell you through email. Please pay attention to you mailbox

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, above the age of 18 and under the age of 30, have attained a senior high school diploma.
